book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso nyaŋe bamii banchvuge batɛŋ
Ajiŋ ayu, Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu gɛɛŋ wu daŋ Mamasi wù Galalee, wu gɛɛŋ wuŋ kwege. Mamasi wunɛ gɛ̀ bee wù ba tɛŋe tɛ lɛ wu Tibɛlia.
Kinchvu ki bamii banyɛ a wu jiŋ nje bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvukugɛ bwe le mu wu gɛ̀ gee fɛ bamii ba binchɛŋ le no wu gɛ̀ fɛde bo.
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ja bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ bo shii yi mbegɛ le.
Gɛ̀ bee sege kɛɛ, Ŋka wu Bajuu wu Ndaŋfe nyu wa abo.
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu noŋ ajii, wu yɛŋ no kinchvu ki bamii too fɛ wu le, wu mo wu biih Filib le lɛ,

content.text: “Bee lé be gê nɛɛ fɛ bee gu mwɛɛ munjile bamii banɛ ji?”

content: Wu gɛ̀ biide noo, wu mone gɛh lo Filib nje wu kibɛɛ gɛ̀ bee wu kee wa fiɛɛ fì wu lé wu gê.
Filib chvuu wu le lɛ, “Gɛ bige bì ba laaŋe mwa wu lɛme yu yi aju le gii yifɛɛ kooji no taŋlo ba gu mwɛɛ munjile mu muh wu mumwaa wu mumwaa bo le kɛmɛ fi shige gɛ.”
Mwa ye wu ŋgoo wumu wù jee che gɛ̀ bee lɛ Andulu wù mwa bwe Samoŋ Bita mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
“Mwa wù jwɛŋsɛ wumu le fɛnɛ wù kɛme chefe yi blɛd yishɛŋ bɛ bíɛŋ yifiɛɛ, geenɛ finɛ fiɛɛ taŋlo fi ge la fɛ kfuu chi banɛ bamii ba duude nɛ le?”
Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ dû bamii baa le lɛ bo shîiyɛ fɛkuu”

content: Gɛ̀ bee agaaŋ nyu fo wesee, bo mo bo jɛmɛ bo shiiyɛ, bilɛŋsɛ maa gɛ̀ bee njɛ banchvuge batɛŋ.
Jiso mo wu jo chefe yi blɛd chiɛɛ, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu mo wu gajɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ shiiyɛ baa le. Wu ge gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ bɛ bíɛŋ chiɛɛ. Muh wuchii kɛme gɛh no wu gɛ̀ goone.
Bo gɛ̀ ji bo fuu, wu jɛme booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bânyɛ bimbɛge, wu lɛ keefɛ fiɛɛ lɛsɛ achiji gɛ.”

content: Noo, bo mo bo banyɛ bimbɛge bi chefe yi blɛd yi yishɛŋ chiɛɛ bì gɛ̀ shɛshɛ, bi yisɛ ŋkáa yuufe ncho yifiɛɛ.
Bamii baa doo bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvukugɛ bwe le finɛ fì wu gɛ̀ ge, bo mo bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wunɛ le nchiɛɛŋ Muh wu Ntuŋ wu Nyo wɛɛ wù gɛ̀ bee ki wu tô yi woŋ kfunɛ le.”
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu yɛŋ lɛ bamii baa goone ki bo to bo koo wu bvuŋga le, bo ghaa Nfoŋ wuboo le, wu mo wu wɛɛŋ wu kaasɛ wu bɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ le wu tu wù nyu yo wu maa.
Jiso jiɛnyɛ yi joo le
Lɛ to nyu fɛnfu, booŋ be ba ŋgoo boh bo gɛɛŋ fɛ mamasi le,
bo lee a ŋguh le bo kɛ bo daŋe bo gɛɛne Kafanahum. Gɛ̀ bee sege kɛɛ akfuuŋ nyu a jiiŋ wa Jiso baaŋ a to gɛ fɛ bo gɛ̀ bee fo gɛ.
Joo gɛ̀ ja yi shiŋshi, nje nfuŋ wu baaŋ gɛ̀ fede lo.
Bo tu bo chiide ŋguh bo daŋe, bo gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ wa bo bu njɛ bama batɛde kɛnɛ banɛh lɛɛ, bo ja bo yɛŋ Jiso le wu jiɛnyi yi joo le wu too wa mbebe yi ŋguh le. Njaŋ koo bo.
Geenɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ, le mɛ!”

content: Bo yu noo, bo mo bo tu bo koŋe ki bo jo wu a ŋguh le. Lɛ bo njaŋɛ, ŋguh fɛɛse wa ŋgɛɛmɛ yi joo le kwa fɛ bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne fo.
Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ bu ayuu, bamii ba gɛ̀ shɛshɛ mamasi wuŋ kwɛge kwaji lɛ ŋguh gɛ̀ bee fo wu mumwaa, Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ lee gɛ a ŋguh wɛɛ le bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛ gɛ, booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ ja bo gɛɛŋ bo maa.
Geenɛ, baŋguh bamu gɛ̀ bee bo ja je Tibɛlia, bo daŋ bo to mbebe kijusɛ kì Tada gɛ̀ jo blɛd fo wu nya kiyone Nyo le, bamii ji.
No bamii bayu yɛŋ lɛ gɛ Jiso kɛnɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo nyu fo gɛ, bo mo bo lee a baŋguh baa le, bo daŋ bo gɛɛŋ Kafanahum ki bo gooŋ Jiso.
Jiso le mwɛɛ munjile mù nyaa kinche
Bo doo bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ wu le wuŋ kwege, bo biih wu le lɛ, “Labai, wo tu to fɛnɛ sege la?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ bɛŋ goone mɛ nyu nje mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvukugɛ bwaŋ bvu bɛŋ yɛde ŋgee le gɛ. Bɛŋ goone mɛ nyu nje bɛŋ chi bɛŋ ji chefe yi blɛd chiɛɛ bɛŋ fuu.

Keefɛ bɛŋ lɛ̂ne gɛh ki bɛŋ kɛ̂me nyu mwɛɛ munjile mù taŋlo mu chɛŋe gɛ. Bɛŋ lɛ̂ne ki bɛŋ kɛ̂me mwɛɛ munjile mù le mu mɛ gɛh mu nyume yu gɛɛŋ bu yi kinche kì kage gɛ le. Mu munɛ le mu, mù muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu nyâ bɛŋ le. Le wu wù Nyo wu le Chiji le wu gɛɛ njiŋɛ we yi ye ye le ki wu dûnyɛ lɛ wu lé wu bɛ̂ɛŋ wu.”

content: Bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Mwɛɛ mù bee kɛme ki be gêe mu mo mu nyû lɛ bee gee nyu lɛme chi Nyo le mù la?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Lɛme chi Nyo le chinɛ chi le lɛ, bɛŋ lêesɛ muntele yi muh wù wu le wu tuŋ le.”

content: Noo, bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvukugɛ bwuŋ fì wo taŋlo wo ge lɛ bee yɛŋ bee mo be leesɛ muntele yi ye yo le, le la? Fiɛɛ fì wo taŋlo wo ge le la?
Bachiji besa gɛ̀ ji mana kwa, nyu no ba saŋ lɛ, ‘Wu gɛ̀ nya bo bɛ mwɛɛ munjile mù jade woŋ wù fɛwe le bo ji.’”
No bo jɛmɛ noo, Jiso mo wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ gɛ̀ bee Musɛ wù gɛ̀ nya mwɛɛ munjile mù jade woŋ wù fɛwe bɛŋ le gɛ. Le Chii wù gɛ̀ nya mwɛɛ munjile mù le mù nchiɛɛŋ mù jade fɛwe.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ mwɛɛ munjile mu Nyo, le mumwɛɛ mù ja fɛwe mu shii mu to mu nyaa kinche bamii ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le.”

content: Bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Tada, wo nyâa bee bɛ mwɛɛ munjile munɛ segechii.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nle mwɛɛ munjile mu nyaa kinche. Gɛ muh wù too fɛ mɛne baaŋ wu ka wu yuge jɛŋ gɛ. Muh wù le wu leesɛ fitele fie yi ye yaŋ le, gɛ kindoŋ baaŋ ki ka ki yune wu gɛ.
Geenɛ nle njɛmɛ wa bɛŋ le lɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ mɛne, bɛŋ faŋ ki bɛŋ lêesɛ fitele ye yaŋ le.
Bamii bachii ba Chii le wu nya mɛne le bo too fɛ mɛne. Muh wù too fɛ mɛne gɛ nyu ŋkuŋ bɛ wu gɛ.
Nja fɛwe nto fɛkuu fɛnɛ. Gɛ nto ki ŋge nyu fiɛɛ fì goone mɛ gɛ. Nto ki ŋge nyu fiɛɛ fì muh wù tuŋ mɛ goone.
Fiɛɛ fì muh wu tuŋ mɛ goone le finɛ fì le lɛ, keefɛ nlɛsɛ lo muh wu mumwaa fɛ bamii ba wu le wu nya mɛne gɛ, geenɛ lɛ, nlé ŋgê mbvûsɛ lo bo yi kwe le juu chi fɛkimɛsɛ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fiɛɛ fì Chii goone le finɛ fì le lɛ muh wuchii wù le wu yɛŋ Mwa ye le, wu leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le, wu lé wu kɛ̂me kinche kì kage gɛ, nlé ŋgê mbvûsɛ mwɛdɛ yi kwe le juu chi fɛkimɛsɛ.”

content: Bajuu mo bo kɛ bo tu bo shuŋshi kune wu nje wu gɛ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Nle mwɛɛ munjile mù ja fɛwe mu to fɛkuu fɛnɛ.”

content: Bo tu bo shuŋshi noo bo biide lɛ, “Wunɛ le gɛ Jiso wu le mwa Yosɛf? Gɛ chiji bɛ bwee nyu besabɛŋ kee bo gɛ?” Fi jiɛnyi nɛɛ mɛɛse fɛ wu tu wu duu lɛ,

content.text: “Nja nyu fɛwe?”

content: Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ shûŋshi lɛbɛŋlɛbɛŋ gɛ.
Gɛ muh taŋlo wu to fɛ mɛne njɛ chile Chii wù tuŋ mɛ lɛ wu to fɛ mɛne sɛŋ gɛ. Nlé ŋge mbvûsɛ mwɛdɛ yi kwe le juu chi fɛkimɛsɛ.
Bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ, ‘Nyo lé wu gê wu yɛ̂yɛ bo bachii.’ Noo muh wuchii wu le wu yu fiɛɛ fì Chii yɛyi wu kɛɛ, lé wu gê wu tô fɛ mɛne.
Gɛ njɛme nɛ lɛ muh le yu wu yɛŋ wa Chii le gɛ. Mɛ gɛh wuwɛɛ wù ja fɛ Nyo le wu le wu yɛŋ wa Chii le.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh wu le wu bɛɛŋ lé wu kɛ̂mɛ kinche kì kage gɛ.
Nle mwɛɛ munjile mù nyaa kinche bamii le.
Bachiji bena gɛ̀ ji mana kwa, geenɛ bo gɛ̀ kweeyɛ gɛ lo.
Mwɛɛ munjile munɛ mu ja fɛwe mu to, nɛ muh le wu ji wu gɛ ka wu kwe gɛ.

Nle mwɛɛ munjile mù ja fɛwe, mù nyaa kinche bamii le. Nɛ muh ji mwɛɛ munjile munɛ, wu mɛ gɛh wu nyume yu segechii. Mwɛɛ munjile munɛ mù nlé ŋgê nyâ wu lɛ bamii ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le kɛmɛ kinche nyu ye yaŋ.”

content: Bajuu mo bo ja bo kɛ bo tu bo waade lɛbolɛbo bo biide lɛ, “Muh wunɛ taŋlo wu ge nɛɛ fɛ wu nya ye ye lɛ bee ji?”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ baaŋ ji gɛ ye yi muh wù jee che le Mwamuh gɛ, bɛŋ mu tɛ kilɛmɛ ke gɛ, bɛŋ gɛ kɛme kinche ye yene le gɛ.
Muh wù jii ye yaŋ wu ka muu kilɛmɛ kaŋ kɛme kinche kì kage gɛ. Nlé ŋgê mbvûsɛ wu yi kwe le juu chi fɛkimɛsɛ,
nje ye yaŋ le lo mwɛɛ munjile, kilɛmɛ kaŋ le fiɛɛ fimule.
Muh wu jii ye yaŋ wu ka muu kilɛmɛ kaŋ wu chee yi ye yaŋ le mɛ tɛ nchee yi ye ye le.
Chii wù tuŋ mɛ kɛme kinche, ŋkɛme kinche nje Chii. Noo muh wu jii ye yaŋ le wù kɛme tɛ kinche nje mɛ.
Munɛ mwɛɛ munjile le mù ja fɛwe mu to. Gɛ mu nyu njɛ mwɛɛ mù bachiji bena gɛ̀ ji bo kweeyɛ lo gɛ. Muh wù jii munɛ mwɛɛ munjile wu lé wu mɛ̂ gɛh wu nyûme yu segechii.”

content: Mwɛɛ munɛ le mù Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme no wu gɛ̀ yɛyi bamii yeh yi buunɛ le Kafanahum.
Bamii ba Jiso ba ŋgoo ba duude chii bikaa a wu jiŋ
Bamii ba Jiso ba ŋgoo ba duude yu n'yɛyɛ wunɛ bo ja bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wunɛ njɛmɛ tɛɛme baaŋ! Taŋlo bɛɛŋ yɛɛŋ wunɛ njɛmɛ?”
Geenɛ, Jiso kɛɛ lɛ bamii be ba ŋgoo lɛ shuŋshi lɛbolɛbo kune njɛmɛ wunɛ, wu mo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fiɛɛ fì njɛme finɛ le fi shiŋshɛ muntele mwɛna?
Nɛ fi le noo, bɛŋ ge nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ yɛŋ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh wu kaase wu bɛɛne fɛ wu gɛ̀ shee wù nyu fo fweele?
Kiyo ki Nyo le fiɛɛ fì nyaa kinche. Gɛ nyaŋ ye kɛme lo fiɛɛ ki yi gê gɛ. Njɛmɛ wù njɛme bɛŋ le, le wu kiyo, le fiɛɛ fì nyaa kinche.
Geenɛ, bɛŋ bamu le bɛŋ yu bɛŋ baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ njɛmɛ wunɛ le gɛ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme nɛ nje wu gɛ̀ kee wa fɛŋkɛɛ bamii ba baaŋ a leesɛ gɛ muntele yi ye ye le gɛ, wu kee tɛ muh wù lé wu gê wu gesɛ wu.
Wu ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ fiɛɛ fì mbe njɛmɛ wa bɛŋ le lɛ gɛ muh taŋlo wu to fɛ mɛne njɛ Chii le wu nya je wu le sɛŋ gɛ.”

content: Ajiŋ ayu, bamii be ba ŋgoo ba duude mo bo chii bikaa a wu jiŋ bo gɛ ka bo jiɛnyi bɛ wu gɛ.
Jiso ja wu biih booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bɛŋ tɛ goone ki bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ gɛ?”

content: Samoŋ Bita chvuu wu le lɛ, “Tada, bee gɛɛŋ nyu fɛ yɛɛŋ le. Kɛme wo njɛme wu nyaa kinche kì kage gɛ,
bee le be bɛɛŋ wa, bee ka be kɛɛ lɛ le wo wɛɛ wu yuude wù ja fɛ Nyo le.”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Cha gɛ mɛ bɛŋ ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ banɛ? Geenɛ, muh mu a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ le debele.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme noo nyu kune Juda wù mwa Samoŋ Ɛkaliot. Wu gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le, gɛ̀ bee wù wu gɛ̀ bee ki wu jîɛnyɛ wu gesɛ Jiso.

footnotes.text: Bige binɛ le a jɛ yi Glek le lɛ badanale gii yifɛɛ.
